title: South Savo: 2.4 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €111,920 a year
markdown:
# South Savo: 2.4 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €111,920 a year

> Closes 2.4 of 3.2 missing patients a year (74%) · €111,920 of €1M · €888,080 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in South Savo, 23 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 6.2 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 2.5–9.6). [^care_curative] [^model] Against Finland as a whole the shortfall is 3.2 patients a year: 2.5 fewer operated and 0.7 fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 23.4% to 26.0% by 2028: 2.4 more patients a year (range 0.0–3.1), for €111,920 a year, about €47,424 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 74% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (3.2 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €19,920 | 0.7 (0.0–1.4) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.2% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 2 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.1 (0.0–1.7) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 12.2% → 13.4% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.6 (0.0–0.6) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 23.4% → 24.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€111,920** | **2.4 (0.0–3.1)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €404,432 a year; modelled to avoid 0.7 deaths a year (0.1–1.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 23.4% (2019–2023, measured) → 26.0% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 12.2% → 13.4% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €888,080 buys nothing more toward treatment to cure. The funded measures are limited by the reachable part of the shortfall, not by money. [^model] To see what else the money could do, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or rank measures by deaths avoided. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 71 deaths a year in South Savo, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.4 of them (range 0.0–0.93). [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 45 new patients and 39 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 1 of them (0 to 2) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 23.4% to 25.4% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- No trial has measured these effects; they are assumptions. Each range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest, and is not a probability. [^model]
- The expected county share is adjusted only for residents' age. It is not adjusted for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, smoking or recording, and county figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured, and none of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]

removed.sentence: This plan does not use the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock, because none of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance.
removed.reason: The causal clause 'does not use ... because' is not in the source. The source calls the clock a secondary, estimated view and reports the 0-of-3 check separately. The clause was cut and the sentence restated as the two supported facts.

flagged.sentence: The remaining €888,080 buys nothing more toward treatment to cure.
flagged.reason: This presented a model result as fact. Added 'In the model', as the source says it 'buys nothing more in the model'.

flagged.sentence: More would come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking by deaths avoided.
flagged.reason: The source does not claim these would yield more. It only says to look at them to see what else the money could do. Rewritten to match that.

flagged.sentence: County shares are adjusted only for residents' age. They are not adjusted for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, smoking or recording, and county figures cannot show cause.
flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted; only the expected share (18.9%) is adjusted for the share of residents aged 65+. Rewritten to say the expected share is adjusted.

pilot.text_fi: Kuuden kuukauden pilotti kahdesta toimesta: rintakirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään stereotaktiseen sädehoitoon. Kuudessa kuukaudessa se tarkoittaa noin 45 uutta potilasta ja 39 arvioitua päätöstä. Jos oletuksemme pitävät, noin 1 heistä (0–2) siirtyy sinä aikana parantavaan hoitoon, ja osuus nousee 23,4 %:sta 25,4 %:iin vuoteen 2028 mennessä. Pilotti korvaa oletukset lasketuilla luvuilla.
pilot.cannot_show_en: Six months is too short to show the county's share moving. It is long enough to count reviews done, decisions changed and referrals made, against the same six months a year earlier.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: Kuusi kuukautta on liian lyhyt aika osoittamaan alueen osuuden muutosta. Se riittää laskemaan tehdyt arviot, muuttuneet päätökset ja lähetteet ja vertaamaan niitä samaan jaksoon vuotta aiemmin.
